remarks: One of Norwalk's most sought-after complexes, ideally situated on the Norwalk/Wilton line. This beautifully maintained community features lush grounds and abundant green space, offering a serene and picturesque setting. Residents enjoy access to a swimming pool and tennis courts for added recreation. This townhome features an open-concept living and dining area with a cozy fireplace and sliding doors that lead to a private deck-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Upstairs, both bedrooms are en-suite with fully updated bathroom and walk in closets, offering comfort and privacy. The finished lower level includes a versatile den and direct access to the attached garage. The unit has been freshly painted, and the garage features a covered overhang for added protection from the elements. Thoughtfully designed throughout, this home is a true gem in the area. Conveniently located close to major shopping centers, train stations, and highways, it offers easy access to everything you need. New high efficiency HVAC, hot water heater, appliances. Home ihas Alexa and Google home controlled LED recessed lighting throughout. Professionaly photography coming Saturday.
